specialNote: These two weigh as much as all eight tricks. The pack is 34 cards, not 32.
bidNotice: Bid a number of POINTS (minimum 7) — not a number of tricks.
discardNotice: You took the kitty. Discard two — the ♥5 and the ♠3 may NOT go.
playNotice: Following suit is compulsory; only legal cards can be chosen.
madeLine: The declaring side made its bid. Both sides keep the points they took.
setLine: Set: the declaring side fell short, so the bid comes straight off its score.
mustBidLine: A side on 45 or more cannot score further unless it bids.

tutorial.info: The hand number, the target and the contract are shown here.
tutorial.players: Each seat's team (T0 / T1). Seats 0 and 2 are partners, as are 1 and 3. Opponents' hands stay hidden until the settlement.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Following suit is compulsory, so illegal cards cannot be chosen.
tutorial.actions: Bid a number of points (7-12). If you win the auction you discard two from the kitty, but never the ♥5 or ♠3.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
